stem.text: Two copper wires S and T, of equal length, are connected in parallel. Wire S has a diameter of $3.0\,\text{mm}$. Wire T has a diameter of $1.5\,\text{mm}$.
A potential difference is applied across the ends of this parallel arrangement.
What is the value of the ratio $\dfrac{\text{current in S}}{\text{current in T}}$?
